statement: A separate typed Edge variant sharing DualSense HID framing is the preferred implementation boundary; linux.uhid.bluetooth is the first proposed HID realization because the inspected Linux kernel matches Edge on the Bluetooth HID bus and consumes its native reports. This is a design inference only: a Bluetooth-bus UHID node is not radio pairing, and feature, descriptor, SDL backend and host acceptance remain unverified.

applicability.scope: virtualgamepad design recommendation; no implementation or host test
